name: Two-Box Sorting Protocol
description: On-board BAS two-box sample sorting experiment sequence for microgravity payloads.

steps.name: Approach Sample Container
steps.guidance: Approach the primary sample storage unit.

steps.name: Identify Red Box Sample
steps.guidance: Locate and confirm visual identification of the red sample box.

steps.name: Pick Red Box Sample
steps.guidance: Grasp and lift the red sample box from storage slot.
steps.voice_alert: Pick up the red sample box.

steps.name: Move Sample to Target Tray
steps.guidance: Transfer the red sample box along designated spatial corridor to target rack.
steps.voice_alert: Move the sample box to the yellow target area.

steps.name: Place Sample in Slot
steps.guidance: Securely position sample box into target tray receiver.
steps.voice_alert: Place the sample box into the target slot.
